Hi Jordan & Sasha,

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear more about Acme's plan to roll out the recommendations engine across Product and Growth. Quick recap and a few procurement/billing questions so we can get a formal quote and legal packet to you: 

Recap
- Pilot: 3-month pilot, up to 100k tokens/day expected peak, Prod rollout target Q4.
- Metrics: latency SLO 150ms p95; target RPS ~50 sustained.
- SE support: Nikhil will help with integration and eval prompts.

Procurement / Billing questions
1) Payment method: Does Acme prefer PO (net terms) or corporate card? If PO, what net terms do you require (net-30, net-45, etc.)?
2) Invoice requirements: Billing address, legal name for invoices, tax ID/VAT or W-9 requirements, and any specific invoice format/line-item requirements (we can provide both PDF and CSV line items).
3) Marketplace: Are you interested in transacting via AWS Marketplace (marketplace procurement) or directly through Redwood? Marketplace may simplify procurement but can affect billing cadence/pricing.
4) PO process: If PO, please attach your PO template or confirm any required fields (PO number, approver, GL code).

I attached a draft quote (Redwood-quote-v1.pdf) that matches the pilot scope discussed. If you can confirm the billing details above and attach the PO template, I can update the quote to include the exact invoicing fields and get a contract drafted for legal review.

Next steps suggestion
- Sasha: confirm preferred payment method and provide billing address + tax ID
- Jordan/Nikhil: confirm pilot start date window and any special invoicing cadence
- I’ll issue an updated quote and send a DocuSign when procurement confirms PO details.

Hi Sasha & Jordan,

Thanks — that all sounds straightforward. A few notes from our side: 

- PO / Net terms: We accept PO with net-30 for enterprise contracts. We can also process a first-month card payment to start the pilot and switch to PO for renewal/production if that's easiest for Acme.
- Invoice format: We can generate PDF invoices and include a CSV of line items if Finance prefers. Our invoices can include: PO number, line-item breakdown, tax/VAT fields, and Redwood's EIN. I will attach a W-9 and our standard invoice template in the follow-up.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (private offers available). Marketplace procurement usually requires a few extra setup steps on our side and can take 1–2 weeks. If you need to start the pilot immediately, recommend transacting directly for the pilot and then moving to marketplace for production.
- VAT/Tax: For US entities we include EIN; for EU customers we support VAT-inclusive invoicing and can add VAT fields if needed.

Next steps I suggest: I’ll update the quote to include the billing address and your PO field. I’ll also attach our W-9 and the invoice template.
